title: Google car with antenna around Płock
description: A Google car with a visible antenna in Poland points to the area around Płock (Masovia).

title: Narrow horizontal upstairs windows (east)
description: Houses with very narrow, horizontal windows on the upper floor are found mostly in the eastern half of Poland.

title: Traditional wooden houses (northeast)
description: Traditional wooden houses, in various colours but always with walls of horizontal planks and a roof of imitation tiles, point to northeastern Poland.

title: Polish asymmetrical pylon
description: Poland has many asymmetrical pylons (a full lower crossarm and a half upper one). Typical are a small beam sticking out of the peak to hold the ground cable, and an upper half crossarm that is just a thin rod with an insulator, which is unique to Poland.
